question: In the biodiesel produced over GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4, what combined area percentage do the two unsaturated methyl esters (methyl linoleate and methyl oleate) make up?
rendered:
Engineering a GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 ternary nanocomposite for enhanced electrochemical performance and biodiesel catalysis

GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4

The area percentage of the two unsaturated methyl esters (methyl linoleate and methyl oleate) can be calculated by adding their individual percentages together. 

Methyl linoleate = 20.51%
Methyl oleate = 27.81%

Combined area percentage = 20.51 + 27.81 = 48.32%
